Step-by-Step Guide

Tap any step timer to launch Cook Mode right there

restaurant_menu
1

Prep & Mix: Pumpkin Pie

Place the pumpkin in a large saucepan, cover with water and bring to the boil. Cover with a lid and simmer for 15 mins or until tender. Drain pumpkin; let cool. Incorporate 3 1/3 cup pumpkin, 1 1/2 cup shortcrust pastry, 1 dusting plain flour, and 9 1/3 tbsp caster sugar smoothly until evenly distributed.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Prep and measure pumpkin first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

2

Build Flavor: Pumpkin Pie

Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface and use it to line a 22cm loose-bottomed tart tin. Chill for 15 mins. Line the pastry with baking parchment and baking beans, then bake for 15 mins. Remove the beans and paper, and cook for a further 10 mins until the base is pale golden and biscuity. Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly. Incorporate 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp nutmeg, 1 tsp cinnamon, 2 beaten eggs, 7/8 oz butter, 11 2/3 tbsp milk, and 1 tbsp icing sugar smoothly until evenly distributed.

3

Shape & Layer: Pumpkin Pie

Increase oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Push the cooled pumpkin through a sieve into a large bowl. In a separate bowl, combine the sugar, salt, nutmeg and half the cinnamon. Mix in the beaten eggs, melted butter and milk, then add to the pumpkin purée and stir to combine. Pour into the tart shell and cook for 10 mins, then reduce the temperature to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Continue to bake for 35-40 mins until the filling has just set.

4

Bake / Chill: Pumpkin Pie

Leave to cool, then remove the pie from the tin. Mix the remaining cinnamon with the icing sugar and dust over the pie. Serve chilled.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

ac_unit

Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!

Nutrition, Storage & Healthy Prep Notes

CALORIES270 kcal
SERVINGS6
SUGAR MODEClassic

Make-Ahead & Storage: Keep pumpkin pie in an airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days (or freeze individual portions up to 1 month). Pair with unsweetened Greek yogurt, fresh berries, or espresso for a balanced treat.

Keto & Low-Sugar Tip: Toggle Healthy Swap above to substitute refined sugar with monk fruit or coconut sugar and white flour with oat or almond flour.
